scope: Session-bound capability discovery and the model/Main invocation gate. Not browser business acceptance (N4/N5).

design.singleTable: electron/services/agent-browser-capabilities.ts owns MODEL_ACTION_REQUIREMENTS: each of the 24 model actions maps to the host-api methods it really needs, plus CLI/facade-local flags.
design.driverFact: Availability comes from the package's real DriverProfile via the already-exported AgentBrowserFacade#getDriverProfile (structural); the profile is built to detect thin-driver refusal stubs by declaration shape. No `typeof api.method === 'function'` inference, no 80-method-contract counting, and the facade wrappers are deliberately NOT the source.
design.deterministicVersion: version = sha256 over the canonical (driverKind, cliAvailable, sorted action/available/reason) map
surfaces: renderer IPC hostApi adapter (electron/services/agent-browser-api.ts withCapabilityGate + status.capabilities)
Gateway bridge (defence in depth: assertActionAvailable before dispatch, status carries the snapshot)
model tool (schema built from the snapshot; execute rejects unavailable actions before invoking)
design.noSideEffects: building the snapshot constructs an api view only; the desktop probe proves status returns the snapshot with 0 sessions created

forgedCall.errorMessage: Agent browser action "downloadFile" is not available: driver "injected" declares downloadFile but refuses them (E_NOT_IMPLEMENTED)

desktopEvidence.note: A hand-forged agentBrowser.downloadFile call is rejected by Main with the refusal-stub reason and creates no session.

matrix.cliAbsent: command is unavailable in both the engine and the host snapshot (no bundled agent-browser in this checkout)
matrix.cliPresent: simulated in unit tests via the injectable capability provider; command routes to the service
matrix.driverDifference: none / injected-full / playwright / refusal-stub profiles are unit-tested and produce different versions and reasons
matrix.staleSnapshot: a tool built from an older snapshot can be stale; Main rejects at the adapter/bridge so no browser effect is possible
matrix.schemaOrder: canonical order preserved; the TypeBox schema is cached by action list so a version bump with the same list does not rebuild it

frozenBounds.reason: the public export map and patched import files are frozen; the capability model therefore lives in the host-owned electron/ layer and reuses the package DriverProfile through the existing facade export.

limitations: Availability advertises driver+environment facts; per-session authorization/revocation is N6.
The 13 additions remain unavailable here; enabling them is N5.
No browser business loop or real-model evidence in this node (N4/N7).
